DE.headline: John Deere Launches AI Agronomist
DE.summary: John Deere has introduced a new AI-powered tool designed to assist with agronomic decision-making.

DE.headline: John Deere to Expand Service Network in Central Asia
DE.summary: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) is providing up to $33 million in financing to Eurasia Group, an exclusive John Deere dealer, to build new service centers in Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan.

DE.headline: Decisive Dividend Corporation Reports Financial Results for the Three and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026
DE.summary: Decisive Dividend Corporation reported a 20% increase in consolidated sales to $40.8 million for the third quarter of 2026, with adjusted earnings per share of $0.28.
